_comment: macOS. Replace every /Users/you/... path with your real one. Always call npx by absolute path AND pass env.PATH — MCP clients spawn servers with a stripped environment, and a missing node makes tools silently never appear. ego is NOT an MCP server and is not listed here: it is driven through the ego-browser skill. Cua Driver's path differs per machine: run `cua-driver mcp-config` after installing it and use the exact output it prints.
_comment_playwright_verified: Playwright is used in the npx form below — verified 2026-11-05 on the test machine (browser_* tools appeared in a fresh Codex session and the Step 3 acceptance passed). If a first-start download stalls, apply the fixed-install pattern described for desktop-commander.
_comment_desktop_commander_fixed_install: RECOMMENDED over the npx form below (verified 2026-11-05): install once with `npm install @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest` into a fixed folder, then use command=/Users/you/node/bin/node and args=["/Users/you/commander-tools/desktop-commander/node_modules/@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander/dist/index.js"] with no env block. The npx form's first-start download stalled on the test machine and the tools never appeared.
